theme: exact roster HASFILELINE DROPEXACTFILE ENSURELINE substring contrast

tests.name: pick_has
tests.cmd: has web hit; has web-prod hit; has webx soft miss

tests.name: ensure_idempotent
tests.cmd: ensure db NEW=1; ensure db NEW=0

tests.name: drop_exact
tests.cmd: drop web leaves web-prod; drop none soft

tests.name: require_miss
tests.cmd: REQUIRE has gone / drop none → exit 2

tests.name: path_asymmetry
tests.cmd: has ghost OK=1 N=0; drop ghost OK=0 REQUIRE exit 2

tests.name: ensure_creates
tests.cmd: ensure on missing path creates file seed

weaknesses.title: HASFILELINE path-miss soft OK=1; DROPEXACTFILE path-miss OK=0
weaknesses.detail: Probe treats missing file as empty membership (N=0 OK=1). Mutating drop hard-fails path (OK=0). Agents sharing REQUIRE logic for has vs drop get different miss codes; ghost path looks like 'not a member' not 'no plate'.
weaknesses.repro: HASFILELINE no_such x → OK=1 N=0; DROPEXACTFILE no_such x → OK=0

weaknesses.title: COUNTFILELINE substring vs HASFILELINE exact — dual semantics trap
weaknesses.detail: contrast web: exact=1 sub=2 (web-prod counted). Needle a hits beta and Alpha with zero exact. Agents mixing GREP-family counts with exact roster membership corrupt allow/deny gates.
weaknesses.repro: roster web+web-prod; COUNTFILELINE web=2 HASFILELINE web=1

weaknesses.title: ENSURELINE creates missing path; DROPEXACTFILE does not
weaknesses.detail: ensure typo path invents ghost roster; drop on same typo soft-fails. No shared existing-only mode. Mirror of KVFILEINC create footgun.
weaknesses.repro: ENSURELINE ghost seed → creates; DROPEXACTFILE ghost → OK=0

weaknesses.title: DROPEXACTFILE / plate WRITE omit trailing NL on last line
weaknesses.detail: After drop last remaining line often lacks $ NL; cat -A shows Alpha glued; META total$4exact$ glue across writes. Agents catting plates see false merges.
weaknesses.repro: cat -A after drop; META after WRITE val

weaknesses.title: HASLINE bag vs HASFILELINE disk; REMOVELINE vs DROPEXACTFILE dual family
weaknesses.detail: In-memory exact bag ops do not touch roster files. Easy to probe bag after READ and mutate disk with different names.

weaknesses.title: Empty CUBALC_ARG1 conflated with missing arg for has/drop
weaknesses.detail: ARG1 empty fails early 'has needs line' via BLANK rather than attempting exact empty-line membership. Cannot probe empty roster lines without env path.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_ARG1= has → EXIT has needs line

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE env silently softens hard gates
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_ER_REQUIRE=abc leaves REQUIRE_HIT=0; has miss returns exit 0.

weaknesses.title: DROPEXACTFILE drops first match only — no DROPALLEXACTFILE
weaknesses.detail: Duplicate exact lines need loop; DROPALLMATCH is substring-only. Roster dedup of exact duplicates awkward.
weaknesses.repro: two identical lines; one drop leaves one

workarounds: Use HASFILELINE not COUNTFILELINE for roster membership
SYS EXIST active before ensure if create-on-miss unwanted
REQUIRE=1 only after digit-check NUM on env
Prefer DROPEXACTFILE over DROPMATCHFILE for hostnames
Reject empty line args at agent layer
language_gaps: Unify path-miss OK policy for HASFILELINE vs DROPEXACTFILE (or document triad)
DROPALLEXACTFILE for exact multi-drop dual of DROPALLMATCHFILE
Help dual HASLINE vs HASFILELINE / REMOVELINE vs DROPEXACTFILE
